The '''Oriolanis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
